newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Brau Union surges on strong 1996 figures.
newsitem.headline: Brau Union surges on strong 1996 figures.

text.p: Shares of Austrian brewer Brau Union surged 5.56 percent in early Thursday trade in a flat Vienna market after parent group BBAG reported a 69 percent surge in 1996 pretax profit on Wednesday.
"That's clearly because of the good earnings and the dividend news," said a trader.
Brau Union is to pay an unchanged dividend of 23 schillings per share for 1996.
At 0820 GMT, the share was 39 schillings at 740. BBAG was up 1.1 percent eight schillings at 718. At the same time, the key ATX index of 21 blue chips was practically unchanged at 1,261.71 points.
Traders said the bull-run in Brau Union's shares was unlikely to be over soon. "There's room all the way up to 770 schillings," said one. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
